block.title: SKEET pods and VANE bladed fliers, encounter concept
block.positive: SNES-era 16-bit pixel art inspired concept rendering, bold dark outlines, saturated limited palette, widescreen 16:9 side-scrolling arcade composition, subtle CRT scanline glow. Close-quarters ambush in the upper atmosphere of a blue planet: three SKEET pods — armored seed-shaped drones with matte gunmetal hulls, rust-violet panel seams and a single glowing magenta eye-slit — crack open mid-flight, hatches folding like petals as they release fan spreads of small pink bullet-orbs with bright cores and dark rims. Two VANE bladed fliers slice through the foreground, steel chassis wreathed by spinning crescent-mirror wingblades catching rim-light, motion implied by doubled blade ghosts. Behind the formation the planet rim glows with a soft cyan atmosphere line, green-teal continent shapes and white cloud swirls floating in a deep navy starfield that lifts from midnight blue to a lighter dusty blue. Clean vector shapes with pixel-art texture accents, ultra-detailed, large-format, colors saturated but limited, background never pure black.
block.negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, watermark, blurry, pure black background, extra eyes, blobby organic bodies
block.notes: Ultra-wide 1536x640 reads like an in-game frame strip, good for website zone sections. sd3.5 handles the bullet-orb repetition well. Keep pods seed-shaped, not round balls.
